label: N1 fails at the selected world…, from At the selected world the spacetime whole… and 3 more
meaning: If the spacetime whole has an existing cause, N1 makes that cause satisfy the thesis predicate, containment makes it a part of spacetime, and UNIVERSE-CAUSE-OUTSIDE-SPACETIME excludes that. So N1 fails; equivalently, N1 with the bridges entails that the universe has no existing cause. Conditional: the caused universe and both bridges are open.
